credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: A softly-shaded mesa rises in the distance from the left side of the work and plateaus in the center of the image.  Several branches, fashioned in a linear manner, cross the mesa in the foreground at a diagonal from right to left.
